title: ProjectOS Session Profile
description: A per-project session profile written to .projectops/sessions/<profile>.json. It selects one of the built-in capability profiles and pins the environment and slot naming for this project. It never contains a credential value; credentials appear as references only, and the built-in profile remains the authority on what may be loaded.

sessionSlots.description: Slot names this profile may occupy, e.g. polygo-1. A slot is a label for one concurrent session, not a permission.

credentialReferences.description: References the session expects to be present. Advisory: the built-in profile's allowlist decides what is actually projected.
